meta.title: T.E.R.R.A. - Strategic Agri-Environmental Reconnaissance and Tracking Rover
meta.description: Autonomous solar-powered agricultural robot for real-time soil moisture monitoring and irrigation optimization in precision agriculture.

hero.title: T.E.R.R.A.
hero.fullTitle: Strategic Agri-Environmental Reconnaissance and Tracking Rover
hero.subtitle: Smart soil monitoring for responsible and efficient water use.
hero.description: An autonomous solar-powered agricultural robot that measures soil moisture zone by zone, delivering precise real-time data without relying on internet access or the power grid.

problem.title: The Water Challenge in Agriculture
problem.subtitle: Water is the most expensive resource to waste and the least measured.
problem.description: In regions with high temperatures and prolonged droughts, like Aguascalientes, irrigation based on schedules or intuition leads to massive losses of water and financial resources.

painPoints.title: Blind Irrigation
painPoints.description: Most small and medium-sized producers irrigate out of habit or by schedule, not based on real soil moisture data, wasting water where it isn't needed.
painPoints.impact: High water waste and unnecessary operating costs.

painPoints.title: Inaccessible Technology
painPoints.description: Existing commercial solutions are extremely expensive ($4,000 to $50,000 MXN) and require complex infrastructure.
painPoints.impact: Exclusion of small producers, community gardens, and schools.

painPoints.title: Dependence on Grid and Internet
painPoints.description: Traditional smart systems fail or cannot be installed in areas without internet coverage or grid electricity.
painPoints.impact: Unviable adoption in isolated or rural land.

solution.title: The T.E.R.R.A. Solution
solution.subtitle: Mobility + Moisture Sensors + Solar Power in a single low-cost platform.
solution.description: T.E.R.R.A. is a mobile robot powered 100% by solar energy that autonomously travels across the terrain, measuring soil moisture in real time. Unlike a rigid automated system, T.E.R.R.A. empowers the producer by giving them precise information to decide exactly where and how much to irrigate.

features.title: Autonomous Solar Navigation
features.description: Fully powered by solar panels, operating without drawing from the electrical grid.

features.title: Real-Time Sensing
features.description: Measures moisture levels in the soil profile point by point with high precision.

features.title: Internet-Free Operation
features.description: Operates completely independently of Wi-Fi or mobile network connections.

features.title: Anomaly Detection
features.description: Identifies atypical moisture variations to prevent water stress or waterlogging.

items.title: Significant Water Savings
items.description: Reduces water resource waste by applying irrigation only in zones with an actual need.

items.title: Data-Driven Decision Making
items.description: Replaces intuition with precise technical and visual diagnostics.

items.title: Zero Operating Energy Cost
items.description: 100% solar-powered, eliminating recurring costs for electricity or disposable batteries.

items.title: Low Acquisition Cost
items.description: Optimized prototyping and engineering with an approximate electronics cost of $2,165 MXN.

items.title: Inclusive and Educational
items.description: Ideal for small producers, school gardens, university projects, and research.

items.title: Agricultural Scalability
items.description: Adaptable platform for incorporating additional sensors in advanced research projects.

valueProposition.title: Unique Value Proposition
valueProposition.statement: T.E.R.R.A. doesn't compete to be the most sophisticated system on the market — it competes to be the most accessible without sacrificing data intelligence.

rows.mainLimitation: Irrigates on a fixed schedule, regardless of whether the soil is already saturated.
rows.terraAdvantage: Real sensing: avoids irrigating when the soil already has sufficient moisture.

rows.mainLimitation: Requires constant internet coverage and nearby grid power.
rows.terraAdvantage: Fully autonomous in power and requires no internet.

rows.mainLimitation: Extremely high investment and maintenance cost.
rows.terraAdvantage: A fraction of the cost with mobility that covers large areas.

rows.mainLimitation: Informational (provides data to inform decisions, does not irrigate directly)
rows.terraAdvantage: Maximum accessibility, mobility, solar autonomy, and precise data.
